name: Saving Grace
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 4, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

For the duration of the spell, if the target creature falls to 0 hp or below, but does not die immediately, he will gain a number of temporary hp equal to half his normal total. These hp will fade at a rate of 1 hp per round.
